evals.name: handoff-with-checkpoint
evals.prompt: I'm in my Orca worktree for the auth 401 bug. I've already found it: in src/auth/refresh.ts the refresh token gets reused after a 401 instead of being rotated. Hand the actual fix off to codex in a fresh worktree, and update my workspace card so I remember what I did. Orca is installed on this Linux box.
evals.expected_output: Uses orca-ide (not bare orca) with --json; reads worktree current before writing; creates an independent worktree with --no-parent --agent codex and a self-contained --prompt; reports the new worktree id + agent handle; does not supervise/wait/resend; updates the card comment preserving the user's note.
assertions: Invoked the Orca CLI via orca-ide (the Linux binary)
Every non-exempt Orca call used --json
Read own worktree state before writing the card
Created a worktree with --agent codex and a --prompt
New worktree is independent (--no-parent)
Brief is self-contained (names refresh.ts and rotation)
Did not use orchestration for a plain handoff
Did not resend or supervise (no terminal send / terminal wait)
Card comment updated and preserves the user's cookie note
Reply reports the new worktree id and agent handle

evals.name: race-script
evals.prompt: Write me a bash script race.sh I can run from any terminal on my Mac. It takes a task description as its argument and races claude, codex and opencode on it, each in its own Orca worktree off main, for my repo (Orca repo id repo-9c1). It should wait for all of them to finish (give each at most 30 minutes) and then print a table comparing each agent's branch, number of commits and diffstat. Don't delete anything.
evals.expected_output: A robust race.sh that drives the orca CLI with --json, checks ok, uses explicit selectors, --no-parent, captures launch handles, bounded tui-idle waits, no blind resends, git-based comparison, no removal.
assertions: race.sh exists and passes bash -n
Uses --json for Orca calls
Targets the repo with an explicit selector id:repo-9c1
Creates independent worktrees (--no-parent)
Launches agents via worktree create --agent (not terminal create + typing)
Captures the agent handle from the launch receipt
Bounded tui-idle wait (terminal wait --for tui-idle --timeout-ms)
Checks the JSON envelope ok/error
Never deletes (no worktree rm / terminal close)
Compares with git (commit count + diffstat)
Does not blindly resend the brief via terminal send

evals.name: repo-setup-config
evals.prompt: Our repo is a pnpm monorepo. Every new Orca worktree needs pnpm install, plus the gitignored .env and apps/web/.env.local files. I want an agent tab and a dev server tab that runs `pnpm --filter web dev`. Agents shouldn't start until the install finishes. The turbo cache in .turbo (gitignored) should be shared between worktrees, not copied. Write whatever config files Orca needs, and tell me anything I need to know to make it work.
evals.expected_output: orca.yaml with scripts.setup, setupAgentStartupPolicy: wait-for-setup, defaultTabs (first tab no command, dev tab), worktree.sharedDirectories [.turbo]; .worktreeinclude with literal .env and apps/web/.env.local; caveats: primary checkout, duplicate keys, tab commands don't wait for setup.
assertions: orca.yaml exists and parses with no duplicate keys
Only keys Orca accepts at top level
scripts.setup runs pnpm install
setupAgentStartupPolicy: wait-for-setup
A defaultTabs entry runs pnpm --filter web dev
First defaultTabs entry has no command (reserved for the agent)
worktree.sharedDirectories includes .turbo
.worktreeinclude lists .env and apps/web/.env.local as literal paths
.turbo is shared, not copied (absent from .worktreeinclude)
Reply explains config is read from the primary checkout
Reply warns tab commands don't wait for setup

evals.name: flaky-mindset
evals.prompt: checkout.spec.ts > 'applies coupon' is flaky, fails about 1 in 5 CI runs. I've already tried adding waits and mocking the clock, neither fixed it. What should we do next?
evals.expected_output: Beyond generic debugging, the agent uses Orca's capabilities: read-only checks (session search, worktree ps / reference find for ownership), recognizes the race trigger (intermittent + 2 failed attempts), proposes a parallel race with a concrete brief and cost, and asks before launching any agent.
assertions: Ran read-only Orca discovery (search and/or worktree ps / reference find)
Launched no agents or worktrees without asking
Proposed racing/parallel agents or a second-agent review, citing why
States the cost (agent sessions/time/review load) of the proposal
Keeps the flake out of the current fix-auth-401 branch
Carries forward the user's card constraint
evals.iteration_2_observation: with_skill: search --index-status, search 'applies coupon', worktree ps; proposed Claude+Codex race with brief, cost and single-agent fallback; asked first. without_skill: generic (good) debugging plan, offered a separate worktree, no Orca-native moves beyond that.
